Practical answers

Asbestos removal FAQs

Clear answers before you book. Each job still needs its own scope, risk controls and price.

How do I know if the material contains asbestos?

You generally cannot confirm asbestos by appearance alone. A suitable sample needs laboratory analysis. If you suspect asbestos, do not cut, drill, sand or disturb it. Send us the location and a brief description so the right assessment can be arranged.

Can Alliance remove friable and bonded asbestos?

Alliance offers Class A asbestos removal capability, including friable and non-friable materials. The removal method, supervision, notifications, containment and independent clearance requirements depend on the material and site conditions.

How much does asbestos removal cost in Brisbane?

Costs depend on the type and condition of the material, the area involved, access, containment, waste disposal, clearance requirements and any repairs. Send us the address, approximate area and photos if available. We will advise whether a site assessment is needed before issuing a scope and quote. Inspection and sampling fees, if applicable, are confirmed before booking.

Can anyone stay at the property during removal?

Do not enter an asbestos removal work area. Whether other parts of the property can remain occupied depends on the asbestos type, work-area isolation and site-specific safety arrangements. We explain the access restrictions before work starts.

Do I receive clearance documentation?

Where licensed asbestos removal requires clearance, the clearance inspection and written certificate are arranged with an appropriately independent person. Class A removal requires an independent licensed asbestos assessor. We explain the records and handover documents relevant to your job.

Can you repair the building after asbestos is removed?

Yes. Alliance also handles associated building repairs and reinstatement, subject to a defined scope, so owners and property managers can coordinate the work through one contractor.

Not sure what has been disturbed? Stop work in the affected area and ask for advice before touching the material.
